randomize_domain_parameters: randomize domain parameters for a Go1 mjx.Model using JAX random keys
apply_friction_randomization: apply random floor friction and joint friction loss to a MuJoCo model
randomize_mass_properties: randomize link masses and torso mass offset for a Go1 robot model
jitter_center_of_mass: jitter the center of mass position of the torso body in a MuJoCo model
randomize_initial_positions: randomize initial joint positions (qpos0) for a Go1 robot model
